boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented UMD rituals, annual campus events, and Bulldog lore spanning athletics, service, cultural learning, and the medical school.

cards.title: The 1933 Bulldog Name
cards.subtitle: A football-team nickname that became UMD identity
cards.notes: Use the UMD Archives account to trace the name back to the spring football team and its first appearance in the Fortnightly Chronicle.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD reports that its spring football team called itself the Bulldogs in 1933, with the name first appearing in the Fortnightly Chronicle on May 3.
cards.access_notes: Historic tradition; read the illustrated UMD Archives story online.

cards.title: Meet Vicky, the Live Bulldog
cards.subtitle: UMD’s live mascot at a 1962 hockey game
cards.notes: Look for the archival photo and story of Semper Victorious, the live bulldog whose UMD debut came at a Michigan Tech hockey game.
cards.short_summary: A real bulldog named Vicky once represented UMD.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD documents that Semper Victorious, known as Vicky, was a live bulldog mascot who debuted at the 1962 UMD–Michigan Tech hockey game.
cards.access_notes: Historic tradition; the source includes an archival image of Vicky.

cards.title: The Mascot Once Called Killer
cards.subtitle: UMD’s plush gray Bulldog, mid-1970s to early 1990s
cards.notes: Compare the archival mascot photos and note the unexpectedly named gray costume that represented UMD for roughly two decades.
cards.short_summary: Before Champ, UMD’s gray Bulldog mascot was called Killer.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says its second Bulldog costume, a plush gray mascot known as Killer, was popular from the mid-1970s into the early 1990s.
cards.access_notes: Historic tradition; consult the official archive story for photos and context.

cards.title: A Student Vote Named Champ
cards.subtitle: Mascot name announced at UMD–Wisconsin hockey in 1997
cards.notes: Read the naming-contest account, then spot Champ at a university athletic event when the mascot is scheduled to appear.
cards.short_summary: Student voters selected the name Champ for UMD’s mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD reports that student voters selected Champ in an athletics naming contest, and the new name was announced at a UMD–Wisconsin hockey game on January 24, 1997.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances vary by event; check the relevant athletics schedule.

cards.title: The Medical-School Key
cards.subtitle: A continuing School of Medicine–Duluth custom
cards.notes: Ask the Medical School about the building-key tradition and its connection to the school’s first cohort of 24 students in 1972.
cards.short_summary: Every UMD medical student receives a building key.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Alumni Relations states that every medical student received a key when the medical school opened in 1972 and that the tradition continues.
cards.access_notes: Applies to UMD medical students; contact the School of Medicine for current participation details.

cards.title: Ojibwe Winter Games at Bagley
cards.subtitle: Cultural games and learning at UMD
cards.notes: Follow AILRC and UMD event listings for future dates; the documented program includes snow snake, hoop-and-spear, and atlatl activities.
cards.short_summary: UMD’s AILRC hosts winter cultural games and instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD documented its second annual Ojibwe Winter Games in 2023, organized by the American Indian Learning Resource Center at Bagley Nature Center.
cards.access_notes: Event dates and participation details vary; verify a current UMD listing before attending.

cards.entity_name: UMD Dia de los Muertos Art Project
cards.title: The Annual Ofrenda Project
cards.subtitle: Art, education, and Dia de los Muertos at UMD
cards.notes: Visit the Multicultural Center and Tweed Museum programming when announced to see how UMD students build a group ofrenda with local schools.
cards.short_summary: A long-running annual UMD project centers respectful Dia de los Muertos learning.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes a more-than-30-year annual class project with the Multicultural Center, Tweed Museum of Art, and local elementary schools for Dia de los Muertos.
cards.source_title: Honoring Diverse Cultural Traditions Through Respectful Art Engagement
cards.access_notes: Program timing varies; check Multicultural Center and Tweed Museum announcements.

cards.title: Homecoming, Bulldog Style
cards.subtitle: A campus-wide UMD spirit week
cards.notes: Check UMD Homecoming’s current schedule for student activities and athletics, then choose an under-21-friendly event that fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: UMD frames Homecoming as a week for students, alumni, and supporters to celebrate together.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s 2026 Homecoming page describes a Homecoming week with student activities, athletic events, and opportunities for the Bulldog community to celebrate together.
cards.access_notes: UMD lists 2026 Homecoming for October 3–10; individual events may have separate requirements.

cards.title: Start Homecoming by Serving
cards.subtitle: UMD Homecoming community cleanup
cards.notes: Watch the current Homecoming student schedule for Service Sunday details, then register through the listed Bulldog Connect event if participation is open.
cards.short_summary: Service Sunday pairs UMD Homecoming spirit with neighborhood cleanup.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies Service Sunday as a Homecoming student activity and says it brings the Bulldog community together during Homecoming week.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Homecoming student schedule for time, location, registration, and supplies.

cards.title: Decorate a Cart, Then Parade It
cards.subtitle: A UMD Homecoming student-organization activity
cards.notes: Form a student-organization team if the current schedule offers it, decorate the assigned cart, and follow the published parade route and timing.
cards.short_summary: UMD Homecoming includes a decorated golf-cart parade for student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s Homecoming page identifies the Golf Cart Parade among its student activities and says student organizations decorate carts before parading them.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Homecoming student schedule for participation rules, route, and timing.
